en: The Analysis of the Bhikkhunī Rules,
Regarding the offenses caused by consenting to physical contact, to which of the four legal issues do they belong?
The offenses caused by consenting to physical contact, among the four legal issues, belong to the legal issue of offenses (āpattādhikaraṇa) …pe….

Regarding the offenses incurred by requesting curd and then eating it, to which of the four kinds of legal issues (*adhikaraṇa*) do they belong? The offenses incurred by requesting curd and then eating it belong, among the four kinds of legal issues, to the legal issue of offenses (*āpattādhikaraṇa*).
The sixth section on legal issues is concluded.
